# Retired companion test fixtures

These schema 2/3 panel bundles and format 1 widget libraries exercise historical transport, endpoint, storage and input behavior in isolated tests. They are not supported imports or product examples. Public host publication admission accepts compiled schema 4 panels only; native tests inject these fixtures through the explicitly named legacy fixture harness.

The flight and racing layouts retain axes, hats, pulses, feedback aging and cancellation coverage. Regenerate their bytes with `node tests/fixtures/legacy-companion/layouts.mjs` and run `node --test tests/fixtures/legacy-companion/layouts.test.mjs`.

The old widget publication generator writes shared-systems and widget-library fixtures here, and native publication goldens under the service's test directory. Check them with `node scripts/widget-publication-fixtures.mjs --check`. ESP32 fixture generators read these files solely for their separate backlog/test contracts.

Use the [generic Toggle source](../../../examples/companion/README.md) for current authoring and browser deployment.
